canonical_title: Strategic Plan of a Registered Training Organisation (CBLM 5)
aliases: Example of a Strategic Plan for a Registered Training Organization (RTO)
Vision, mission, key measures, strategies and key activities

one_line_answer.text: Regardless of its size every RTO needs to develop a strategic plan.

cites.quote: Regardless of its size every RTO needs to develop a strategic plan.

keywords.bn: প্রতিষ্ঠান কী করে, কাদের সেবা দেয়

bangla_explanation: ছোট হোক বা বড়, প্রতিটি RTO-র একটি strategic plan লাগে; এটা long-term, সাধারণত এক বছর থেকে পাঁচ বছর বা তার বেশি।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের strategic plan পড়ে তার future goals and objectives জানুন; তারপর নিজের personal work goals সেটার সাথে মিলিয়ে নিন।
CBLM-এর উদাহরণে plan-এর পাঁচটি অংশ: Vision, Mission, key measures of success, strategies আর key activities।
Quality plan এই strategic plan-কে support করে; দুটো এক জিনিস নয়।

example.en: A TTC in Dhaka has a five-year strategic plan. An instructor reads it before setting his yearly goals.
example.bn: প্রতিষ্ঠানের পাঁচ বছরের plan জানা থাকলে instructor নিজের বছরের লক্ষ্য সেই দিকেই ঠিক করেন।

mnemonic.text: V-M-K-S-A: Vision, Mission, Key measures, Strategies, Activities
mnemonic.explain_bn: উপর থেকে নিচে: স্বপ্ন → পরিচয় → সাফল্যের মাপ → কৌশল → কাজ।

list_answer.title: Parts of the example strategic plan for an RTO

items.text: Vision: provide qualifications to support continuous improvements in client organizations.

cites.quote: To Provide Qualifications to support continuous improvements

items.text: Mission: a customer oriented, nationally competitive RTO serving national and Asia pacific companies.

cites.quote: A customer oriented, nationally competitive Registered Training
Organization serving national and Asia pacific companies

items.text: Key measures of success for the national training system, suppliers, customers and employees.

cites.quote: Key measures of our success will be:
National Training Suppliers Customers Employees System

items.text: Strategies: developing competitive advantages, improving business performance, business development, strengthening relationships.

cites.quote: We will achieve these outcomes with these strategies
Developing Improving Business Strengthening Competitive Business Development Relationships Advantages Performance

items.text: Key activities for using these strategies.

cites.quote: We will achieve these outcomes with these strategies

items_bn: Vision — প্রতিষ্ঠানের স্বপ্ন: qualifications দিয়ে client organizations-এর continuous improvement-এ সাহায্য করা।
Mission — প্রতিষ্ঠানের পরিচয়: customer oriented, দেশে প্রতিযোগিতা-সক্ষম RTO, যা দেশ ও Asia pacific-এর companies-কে সেবা দেয়।
Key measures — চারটি ক্ষেত্রে সাফল্য মাপা হয়: national training system, suppliers, customers আর employees।
Strategies — চারটি কৌশল দিয়ে এই ফল আনা হবে: competitive advantages, business performance, business development, relationships।
Key activities — প্রতিটি কৌশলের নিচে বাস্তবে কী কী কাজ করা হবে, তার তালিকা।

traps.text: A strategic plan is long-term: usually one year and up to five years or more.

cites.quote: Strategic plans are long-term, usually one year and up to five years or more.

traps.text: The quality plan supports the strategic plan. They are two different plans.

cites.quote: An institution's strategic plan is supported by a quality plan.

visual.title: Strategies and sample key activities (p.8-9)
visual.title_bn: চারটি কৌশল: মানে আর একটি করে মূল কাজ

rows.text: Exceeding customers' expectations and improving own competitive position by researching industry skill needs.
Increase the overall level of skills/qualifications of our people.
Getting best practice performance in service delivery costs. Improve process, equipment and facilities; reduce waste.
Implement a Waste Minimization Program, including paper usage reduction and recycling.
Growing the RTO through new learning and assessment materials and new clients.
Develop new targeted markets for Certificate IV and Advanced Certificate in CBT&A.
Developing our values, behaviours and external relationships with stakeholders.
Conduct program surveys with program participants and their employers.

short.prompt: What is a strategic plan? What does the CBLM example of an RTO strategic plan include?
short.modelAnswer:
Regardless of its size, every RTO needs a strategic plan. Strategic plans are long-term, usually one year and up to five years or more.
The example strategic plan has:
1. Vision
2. Mission
3. Key measures of success
4. Strategies
5. Key activities
Refer to it to know future goals. Make your personal work goals support it.
